item.title: Heavy rain causes mass pileup in Brazil tunnel
item.description: Flooding left vehicles piled up and people stranded inside Sao Paulo’s Anhangabau tunnel.

item.title: X suspends 13,000 accounts, alleging foreign influence ahead of US midterms
item.description: The social platform says networks targeted US political debate across the spectrum ahead of midterm elections.

item.title: Argentina’s Milei backs Trump for US midterms, calls vote crucial for West
item.description: The US President's ally says conservatives “cannot give an inch” in Latin America as he accepts an award in Washington.

item.title: Albanian Ministry of Justice on fire as education protesters riot
item.description: Hundreds of students joined anti-government protests in Tirana, demanding education reforms.

item.title: OpenAI bugging suspect allegedly booked one-way trip to Saudi Arabia
item.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan was due to fly to Saudi Arabia on October 12, US prosecutors say in court filing.

item.title: North Korea tests two submarine-launched missiles, state media reports
item.description: The tests showcase North Korea's war deterrent capabilities in the region, KCNA says.

item.title: Teenager dies as heavy rain floods Istanbul
item.description: Roads collapse and hospitals take in water as floods swamp Turkiye's largest city, shutting schools and halting traffic.

item.title: Trump administration seeks to strip Ilhan Omar of US citizenship: WSJ
item.description: Investigators have subpoenaed relatives and examined immigration records, the newspaper reports.

item.title: Trump plays Muslim Brotherhood card against Senate candidate El-Sayed
item.description: President Donald Trump says Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is a member of the Muslim Brotherhood.

item.title: Kenya’s Ebola cases test preparedness beyond Nairobi
item.description: The scare exposed gaps in how far outbreak readiness reaches Kenya’s remote communities.

item.title: Tunisia: What has Kais Saied achieved economically in seven years?
item.description: Rising prices, unemployment and public debt test Saied’s economic promises.

item.title: White House spokesperson Katie Zacharia’s law career faces scrutiny
item.description: Katie Zacharia has repeatedly claimed to be a lawyer, but critics question whether she was ever licensed.

item.title: Trump suggests those who leak government information should ‘be shot’
item.description: The US president has long been unhappy with inside information about his administration being leaked to the media.

item.title: Istanbul in chaos, shut down by heaviest rainfall since 1985
item.description: Torrential rain has triggered flash floods across Istanbul.

item.title: Ship catches fire in Romania’s waters amid rising attacks in the Black Sea
item.description: Authorities are investigating whether drones may have been involved in the latest incident.

item.title: Costa Rica opens mega-prison as Bukele model embraced across Latin America
item.description: President Laura Fernandez says mega-prison is part of 'tough-on-crime model' embraced by her government.

item.title: Mexican court closes case against official over 2023 detention centre fire
item.description: Victims' groups, however, have denounced the ruling as 'selective' justice that exonerates the former migration chief.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran vows to fight until US yields as ships sink in Hormuz
item.description: Iran says it does not seek an endless war, but vows to fight until the US accepts its demands as ships sink in Hormuz.

item.title: US destroys dhow suspected of Iranian command and control
item.description: The US says it destroyed an Iran-affiliated boat in the Gulf of Oman, accusing it of conducting surveillance.

item.title: Denmark pushes back as Trump touts Greenland oil and mineral deals
item.description: Recent US-Greenland-Denmark agreement excludes mining or drilling rights while reinforcing Greenland's sovereignty.

item.title: ICE rejects recommendation for body cameras that automatically record
item.description: The immigration agency rejects a report from a government watchdog recommending improvements to its body camera policy.

item.title: Real Madrid come from 3-1 down to beat Roma on Champions League travels
item.description: Real Madrid ease pressure on manager Jose Mourinho with a 4-3 win at his former club Roma in a Champions League classic.

item.title: PSG beat Man City 4-2 in Champions League thriller
item.description: PSG score three first-half goals, but an Erling Haaland brace nearly drags Manchester City back into the match.

item.title: Colombia opposition groups launch protest against de la Espriella’s cuts
item.description: Former President Gustavo Petro joined thousands of demonstrators in Bogota in march against austerity, Israel ties.

item.title: West Indies beat India to level T20 series as Hope continues record run
item.description: Shai Hope’s 102 gives West Indies a 24-run series-leveling win over India in fourth cricket T20 as another record falls.
